blockers.detail: Library added Billion Laughs Attack protection with 3 dimensions: (1) API - two new configuration functions to set amplification limits; (2) State - entity expansion tracking across parse calls with accountingDiffTolerated(); (3) Configuration - default thresholds for maximum amplification and activation. Old OSS-Fuzz harness does not call the new APIs, does not test entity expansion attacks, and relies on default protection which may not cover all attack vectors. Nearly 1000+ lines of protection logic have 0% coverage.

evidence: Commit b1d03960 adds comprehensive billion laughs attack protection
State tracking: accountingDiffTolerated() tracks entity expansion across multiple parse calls
OSS-Fuzz harness at this time does not invoke these APIs or test entity expansion scenarios

rationale.zh: expat库新增了全面的Billion Laughs攻击防护机制，涉及三个维度：(1) API维度 - 新增2个配置函数来设置放大倍数限制；(2) State维度 - 通过accountingDiffTolerated()等函数跨解析调用跟踪实体扩展状态；(3) Configuration维度 - 添加默认阈值配置特性。但OSS-Fuzz的harness未调用新API，未测试实体扩展攻击场景，仅依赖默认防护。新增的1000+行防护逻辑代码覆盖率为0。这是典型的mix类退化，必须同时修复API调用、状态测试和配置测试才能消除gap。
rationale.en: expat library added comprehensive Billion Laughs Attack protection involving 3 dimensions: (1) API - two new configuration functions to set amplification limits; (2) State - entity expansion tracking across parse calls via accountingDiffTolerated() and related functions; (3) Configuration - default threshold configuration features. However, OSS-Fuzz harness does not call the new APIs, does not test entity expansion attack scenarios, and only relies on default protection. The 1000+ lines of new protection logic have 0% coverage. This is a典型 mix degradation - all three dimensions must be addressed to eliminate the gap.
